summary: v2-07 replicated run-level for its schema half: r05 unanswerable in 14 of 15 designs with x1_cas_ledger the only design answering it, r01/r03 partial in the same 14, r02/r04 answerable in all 15, in two whole runs of all fifteen designs in both design orders (plus two verify-only pre-checks kept as a labelled pre-check because report_coverage is emitted in the read phase). Its storage figure is now a band naming the rule: tables only 33.4-35.2%, all relations 35.0-36.2%, indexes 37.7%; M4 (reproducible within 1%) is falsified - the delta moved 0.9 percentage points because relation size carries the load's free space. Book prose re-scoped to +33-38%. Merged to main 35877d8, tagged study-02-t1-remaining-v1 and study-02/v2-07-answerability-replication. The survey ranks v2-08's PostgreSQL refund/organiser-edit arms first and records the yb-cluster3 arms as not fitting the fixed machine.
